MATCH (source:PlantItem {tag: "TK-1-1"})-[:send_to*1..]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target <> source
  AND toString(target.unit_id) = "1"
  AND any(label IN labels(target) WHERE label IN ["Equipment", "OperatedValve", "BallValve", "GlobeValve", "CheckValve"])
RETURN DISTINCT target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE item:BallValve OR item:GlobeValve OR item:CheckValve OR item:OperatedValve
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag
